Guide

How HGV training works

HGV training is a sequence, not a single lesson. You say what you want to drive, the licence you already hold is checked, and the medical, theory and practical steps are planned around that. No duration is stated here.

On this page

  1. The enquiry
  2. The licence check
  3. Medical, theory and the vehicle
  4. The test

The enquiry

Say which vehicle you want to drive, or that you are not sure. Say which of the example bases you prefer. The form asks for a contact method. It does not book a test.

  • Enquiry form

The licence check

What you already hold changes the route. A car licence towards Category C is a different plan from Category C towards Category C+E. Driver CPC may sit alongside either, and it may not, depending on the work.

  • Which licence is right for me?

Medical, theory and the vehicle

A first lorry licence normally includes a medical, theory tests and practical training. The practical work is yard manoeuvres and driving on the road, in a vehicle of the right kind.

Periodic Driver CPC is different. It is a training module for a driver who already holds a professional entitlement, not a first driving test.

  • HGV medical explained
  • Driver CPC

The test

Licence courses lead towards a practical test. How the test is booked is explained when you enquire. This site does not claim a pass rate.

  • What happens on an HGV driving test?

Related

Courses

  • Category CPractical training for rigid goods vehicles over 3.5 tonnes, for drivers moving up from a car licence.
  • Category C+ETrailer training for drivers who already hold Category C and need the articulated or drawbar entitlement.
  • Driver CPCPeriodic training for professional drivers who need hours towards a Driver Qualification Card.

Guides

  • Which HGV licence do I need?The licence depends on the vehicle you want to drive, and on what you already hold. This guide separates the main goods-vehicle entitlements from Driver CPC. It does not confirm that you qualify.
  • HGV medical explainedA medical is a normal part of getting a lorry licence. This page explains where it sits in the process. It does not say that you will pass, and it does not book an appointment.
  • What happens on an HGV driving test?The practical test checks that you can control the vehicle and drive it on the road. The detail is set by DVSA and can be updated, so treat this as an outline and check the official description before test day.

Ask about training

If you know which course you need, say so. If you are not sure, say that too.
